faqs.a:
(a)
No person or household shall own or have custody of more than:
(1)
Three dogs of more than four months of age; or
(2)
Four cats of more than four months of age; or
(3)
Two pot-bellied pigs of more than four months of age; or
(4)
A total of four dogs and cats of more than four months of age in any combination;
               or
(5)
A total of three dogs and pot-bellied pigs of more than four months of age in any
               combination.
(b)
In addition to the limits on the number of dogs, cats, and pot-bellied pigs that may
               be kept or owned, no person or household shall keep, own, or have custody of more
               than a total of 15 other animals, such as chickens, domestic fowl, miniature goats,
               turkeys, or pet or domesticated animals of any age or combination.
(Code 1981, § 6-65; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998;
Ord. No. 4118, § 4, 7-7-2008
;
Ord. No. 4502, § 4, 5-18-2015
)
